tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Vionvision Blue (website --OneColor, logo fill), kept exact. Logo, primary buttons, full-bleed emphasis blocks, the slash motif, chart series 1. As a fill carries `on-brand` text. Not for text on tints or grey grounds — text takes `brand-text`. Keep to ~10% of any page or slide.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Accent text: links, page numbers, key figures, step numbers, bullets. A darker cut of `brand` for text only (brand stays #0066ff for logo and fills). Light: 5.77:1 on `surface`, 5.12:1 on `surface-alt`, 5.15:1 on `table-head`, 4.68:1 on `brand-tint`. Dark: 6.83:1 on `surface`, 5.96:1 on `surface-alt`, 5.43:1 on `table-head`, 4.93:1 on `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and white logo on `brand` fills (4.83:1, both themes).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Info callouts and the 'In progress / PMI' status fill in documents. `ink` text on it; `ink-muted` reads 4.65:1 (light).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Website footer colour, kept exact. Dark slide grounds, cover and closing slides, dark bands. Text on it: `on-brand` (white, 17.4:1); blue accent text on it: `on-navy-accent` (6.83:1) — never #0066ff text (3.6:1). `brand` fills (blocks, slashes) on navy are fine (3.6:1, non-text).

tokens.name: on-navy-accent
tokens.usage: Blue accent text on `navy` grounds in both themes: links, KPI figures, highlighted words on dark slides and bands. 6.83:1 on `navy` (#0c1b2b), 5.96:1 on dark `surface-alt` (#14273b). Not for light grounds — there use `brand-text`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Website section band. Alternating sections, product render backdrops, sidebar panels, KPI tiles.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row and first-column label cells in documents. `ink` bold text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Website --FontOneColor. Headings and body text on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `table-head` and all tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, meta lines, captions, header runner, footer, KPI labels. Light: 5.74:1 on `surface`, 5.09:1 on `surface-alt`, 5.13:1 on `table-head`, 4.65:1 on `brand-tint`, 4.91:1 on `success-tint`, 5.05:1 on `warning-tint`. Dark: 8.3:1 on `surface`, 5.97:1 or more on every dark tint.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: inactive tabs, timestamps, long product descriptions. Light: 5.1:1 on `surface`, 4.52:1 on `surface-alt`, 4.55:1 on `table-head`. Dark: 6.62:1 on `surface`, 5.78:1 on `surface-alt`, 4.78:1 on `table-head`. The website grey #8d8d8d is kept as `chart-4` (a fill, not text).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Table cell borders, hairline dividers under eyebrows and card labels. Decorative only; never the only cue that separates meaning.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: 'What we all gain', 'Next step' callouts and the Done / Accepted status fill. `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Status word 'Done' / positive delta text on `surface` or `success-tint` (4.6:1). Always paired with a word or ✓, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Partner / installer-owned stages and caution callouts. `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Status word 'At risk' / 'Waiting' on `surface` or `warning-tint` (4.78:1). Pair with a word.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Grey status fill: stages owned by Vionvision internally or not started.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Secondary accent from the website, kept exact. Decorative fill only (a marker, a small block). Never text (2.19:1 on white) and not a chart series on white — use `chart-5`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — Vionvision / the subject being measured.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — comparison / baseline.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — light blue; secondary breakdown or the non-highlighted bars behind a `chart-1` bar. 1.9:1 on white, so always pair it with direct data labels or a legend label next to the mark; never the only cue.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 — the website grey #8d8d8d (3.32:1 on white); 'other', previous period, benchmarks.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 / single highlight (one bar, one point). Light uses a deeper orange so the mark holds 3.54:1 on white; dark uses `accent-orange` (8.0:1 on navy). The website orange #fe9454 stays exact as `accent-orange` for decorative fills.

families.display: "Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0", "Alibaba PuHuiTi", Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Cover and section-divider headline (44 pt in PowerPoint; 88px on a 1920×1080 canvas); website hero. Max two lines.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Content slide title, 28 pt in PowerPoint — states the message, not the topic.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Footfall, dwell time and conversion from every entrance, reported daily in V-store.
styles.usage: Slide body and bullet text, 16 pt in PowerPoint. Never below 14 pt (28px).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section marker above a title, 14 pt in PowerPoint: slash, two-digit number, word. `ink-muted` on content slides, white on dividers.

styles.name: stat-figure
styles.usage: KPI numbers on slides and one-pagers, in `brand-text`, label under it in `body`/`ink-muted`.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Report title (16 pt in Word). Upper case, centred or left, once per document.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Numbered section heading (13 pt). Title Case.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: What we will measure in the pilot

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each store sits in exactly one stage. The colour shows whose action moves it forward.
styles.usage: Document body and table text (10 pt, 1.15 line spacing).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Header runner, footer, chart source lines, captions (8–8.5 pt) in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (vertical), gaps inside callouts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (horizontal), list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Callout padding, gap between paragraph and table.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a numbered section heading in documents.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on slides; gap between KPI tiles.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide inner margin at 1920×1080 is 2× this (96px).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section separation on web pages and one-pagers.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Tables, callouts, cards, image crops, colour blocks — the brand is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags and status chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Screenshot frames of the V-store platform UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only ('Contact us', 'Request a Demo').

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating card over a photo or `surface-alt` (website blog cards). Not in printed documents.

tokens.name: shadow-brand-glow
tokens.usage: Hover / focus glow on primary buttons on the web only.

motif.note: The slash: every diagonal in the brand uses this angle — hero blocks, section markers, progress bars, the corner tick on cards.

tokens.name: slash-angle
tokens.usage: CSS skewX for slash blocks and bars (website uses -30° to -35°). In PowerPoint: parallelogram shape, ~30° lean to the right.
